unknowns.item: Geocoder puts the Institut on the wrong plot
unknowns.why: Typing 'Camí Antic de València 35' or '37' lands on plot 3241427DF3834A (Escola Pere IV, red). The Institut is on 3241428DF3834A (yellow, Batista 1). Running step 01 from the Institut's address gives the wrong roof.
unknowns.next: Run the yellow roof from its point or its refcat (as data/host/cep9_yellow.json does), not from the address.

unknowns.item: Where the real panel blocks are
unknowns.why: All 108 panels are on the Institut [CEP9, email from César Ochoa, 27 Nov 2026]. Step 02 now finds 3 rectangles there (253.6 m², about 86 panels); 4 others were not panels (checked by eye, Breno 27 Nov 2026, step02_pv_capacity/not_panels.csv). Our step 03 layout fits only 85 panels of 540 W on that roof (south-facing rows spaced for no shade at a 25° sun); the real plant is East-West 'Delta Wing', back to back.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 or the installer for the panel plan and row spacing, to explain the 11 missing panels.

unknowns.item: Fire station outline is cut off, and it already has PV
unknowns.why: Its plot runs onto LiDAR sheet 432584, which we do not have, so the north-west end of the building (with panels on it) is missing. The roof already carries many panels, so as a guest it may need less from CEP9.
unknowns.next: Download ICGC LiDAR sheet 432584 and rerun step 01; count its panels in step 02.

unknowns.item: Where the 30 homes are and what they use
unknowns.why: Location private: CEP9 does not publish where the homes are. The 400-700 kWh/yr is their share of the solar, not what they use.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 for the homes' total use only (no addresses needed); until then use a typical home profile.

unknowns.item: Real hourly demand of every participant
unknowns.why: Every member's demand is an average per building type, not a meter reading.
unknowns.next: Ask the Ajuntament (Datadis / municipal energy office) for 2023-2025 hourly data for the 4 public buildings. CEP9 has monitoring data and it has been requested [CEP9, email from César Ochoa, 27 Nov 2026].

unknowns.item: Real sharing coefficients and the tariff each member pays
unknowns.why: Shares now known [CEP9, email from César Ochoa, 27 Nov 2026]: Institut 0.30, Maria Espinalt 0.13, Can Felipa 0.13, fire station 0.14, 30 homes 0.30. The coefficient file is prepared by the Barcelona Energy Agency and sent via Barcelona Energia to Endesa Distribución (so no manager fee). The tariff each member pays is still unknown.
unknowns.next: Ask CEP9 which tariff each member pays (PVPC or market).

unknowns.why: Members are 10-258 m from the Institut, edge to edge (step 01 map). CEP9's reach is 2 km / 5 km [CEP9, email from César Ochoa, 27 Nov 2026]. Only Can Felipa and the fire station are inside the tool's 100 m for direct wiring.
unknowns.next: Run step 07 with --max-distance 2000 (as the website does).
